```yaml
---
id: vuln-novnc-ad941fad
languages:
  - javascript
message: Potential security vulnerability in WebUtil.createCookie
severity: ERROR
metadata:
  CVE: CVE-2013-7436
  CWE: CWE-310
pattern: 
  metavar: "vulnerable_code"
  metavar-regex: "(?s)WebUtil.createCookie\\s*=\\s*function\\s*\\((name,value,days)\\s*\\){.*?var\\s+date,\\s+expires(,\\s+secure\\s*)?;.*?if\\s*\\((days)\\).*?date\\.setTime\\((days\\*24\\*60\\*60\\*1000)\\).*?expires\\s*=\\s*\"(;\\s*)?expires\\s*=\\s*\\".*?document\\.cookie\\s*=\\s*name\\+\"=\"\\+value\\+expires\\+\";\\s*path=/\\".*?if\\s*\\(document\\.location\\.protocol\\s*===\\s*\"https:\".*?secure\\s*=\\s*\"(;\\s*)?secure\\s*=\\s*\\".*?document\\.cookie\\s*=\\s*name\\+\"=\"\\+value\\+expires\\+\";\\s*path=/\\"\\+secure\\s*.*?}"
taint-mode:
  metavar: "patched_code"
  metavar-regex: "(?s)WebUtil.createCookie\\s*=\\s*function\\s*\\((name,value,days)\\s*\\){.*?var\\s+date,\\s+expires,\\s+secure\\s*;.*?if\\s*\\((days)\\).*?date\\.setTime\\((days\\*24\\*60\\*60\\*1000)\\).*?expires\\s*=\\s*\"(;\\s*)?expires\\s*=\\s*\\".*?document\\.cookie\\s*=\\s*name\\+\"=\"\\+value\\+expires\\+\";\\s*path=/\\".*?if\\s*\\(document\\.location\\.protocol\\s*===\\s*\"https:\".*?secure\\s*=\\s*\"(;\\s*)?secure\\s*=\\s*\"(;\\s*)?secure\\s*=\\s*\\".*?document\\.cookie\\s*=\\s*name\\+\"=\"\\+value\\+expires\\+\";\\s*path=/\\"\\+secure\\s*.*?}"
```
This Semgrep rule will detect the vulnerable behavior of the `WebUtil.createCookie` function in JavaScript. It uses pattern and taint-mode to detect the vulnerable code and the patched code. The pattern field is used to detect the vulnerable code and the taint-mode field is used to detect the patched code. The rule is set to ERROR severity to highlight the potential security vulnerability.
